label: cut
note: The default. Costs nothing and is the only transition the assembly path executes for free.

label: smash cut
text: abrupt cut against the prevailing rhythm
note: A rhythm claim, not a render claim — it is a cut whose neighbours are long.

label: match cut
text: cut on a shared shape or motion across two scenes
note: Excluded from the camera vocabulary at SHOT-GRAMMAR §V because it is a cut, not a move — but it is expressible here, as a constraint on the two clips either side.

label: jump cut
text: cut forward in time within the same framing

label: dissolve
text: one image fading into the next

label: wipe
text: one image pushing the other off frame along an edge

label: iris
text: circular mask closing or opening on the frame

label: J cut
text: audio of the next shot beginning under the current one
note: An audio-led transition. LTX generates no audio; this is arranged on the DAW side. SHOT-GRAMMAR §I.

label: L cut
text: audio of the current shot continuing under the next

label: whip pan transition
text: two shots joined through a blurred pan
note: Requires the move to exist in both clips. Whip pan is excluded at SHOT-GRAMMAR §V.
